capabilities: Animates caret moves with distance-aware CSS transitions
Hides the native caret and draws a custom caret layer
Handles IME composition, drag selection and multiple cursors
Configures duration, easing and caret height
Toggles the effect from settings or the command palette
disambiguation: Not a navigation or cursor-movement tool; it only animates how the caret arrives at positions the editor already moves it to.
extras: Desktop only; mobile untested. Conflicts with other caret-modifying plugins, run one at a time; stands down automatically under Vim mode. Bilingual English/Chinese README.
intentEvidence: An animated caret for the Obsidian editor.
motivation: To give Obsidian a VS Code-style caret glide, which required hiding the native caret and drawing an animatable caret on the text layer.
problem: Obsidian's caret is the browser's native insertion caret painted by the compositor, so it cannot be animated and every cursor jump teleports instantly.

relations.evidence: it glides to its new position instead of teleporting there, the way the caret behaves in VS Code

summary: Animated editor caret that glides smoothly between positions instead of teleporting, with distance-aware timing and IME-safe behavior.
